title: Bisection update
statement:
In bisection, $f(x_l) f(x_m) > 0$. What do you do?

[_]{a}

choices: Set $x_l = x_m$ (the root is in the right half)
explanations: That keeps a half with no sign change.

hints: Same sign at x_l and x_m.
solution: Same signs mean no sign change on the left, so the root is in [x_m, x_u].
